contracts.name: source_release_contract
contracts.description: 55,500-row source CSV must pass all 27 GE expectations before any data lands in BigQuery
contracts.failure_impact: Halts entire ingestion pipeline; no data lands in warehouse
contracts.soft_exception: Billing Amount 108 rows (0.19%) via mostly:0.995 -- tracked, not blocking

contracts.name: l1_data_quality_contract
contracts.description: 33-column enriched schema: vitals ranges, ESI tier enum, PII cleared, row_hash unique
contracts.failure_impact: Blocks dbt mart builds; AI-facing API serves stale data

contracts.name: clinical_plausibility_hard_block
contracts.description: Age x medication combinations must be medically plausible. Under-18 + adult-only drugs = hard block regardless of schema validity.
contracts.last_result: PASS -- 0 hard violations in enriched corpus
contracts.failure_impact: Semantically absurd rows reach AI layer; agent gives clinically dangerous responses

contracts.name: enriched_ai_contract
contracts.description: 497-row AI-facing corpus must have all 21 enrichment columns populated. Last gate before agents consume data.
contracts.failure_impact: BM25 retrieval returns incomplete context; agent responses are ungrounded

contracts.name: patient_identity_contract
contracts.description: Every encounter must resolve to a stable patient_id. Unresolved < 0.1%.
contracts.last_result: PASS -- 40,235 canonical patients; 47 unresolved (0.12% WARN band)
contracts.failure_impact: Patient count KPI inflated; RAG lookup returns cross-patient context
contracts.soft_exception: 47 unresolved (0.12%) -- above strong threshold 0.10%; tracked in l1_checkpoint_report.json

contracts.name: source_to_warehouse_reconciliation
contracts.description: Every source row must be accounted for: source_rows == clean_rows + quarantine_rows. No silent row loss.
contracts.failure_impact: Silent data loss; incorrect patient counts; audit failure

contracts.name: ai_safety_no_bad_data
contracts.description: Zero semantically incorrect records must reach the agent-facing API. gate_publish() blocks all CRITICAL faults. stale_data_incidents must equal 0.
contracts.failure_impact: Agent serves clinically incorrect data to downstream consumers
